title: C4 Therapeutics Presents Phase 1 Data at European Hematology Association (EHA) 2026 Congress Highlighting Cemsidomide as a Potential Best-in-Class IKZF1/3 Degrader for Multiple Myeloma in Heavily Pretreated Relapsed/Refractory Population
summary: At the 100 µg Recommended Phase 2 Dose (RP2D), Cemsidomide Demonstrated a 53% Overall Response Rate, Including Complete Responses and Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Negative Status Cemsidomide Was Well Tolerated With Minimal Discontinuations and Dose Reductions Related to Safety or Tolerability
body_text: At the 100 µg Recommended Phase 2 Dose (RP2D), Cemsidomide Demonstrated a 53% Overall Response Rate, Including Complete Responses and Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Negative Status Cemsidomide Was Well Tolerated With Minimal Discontinuations and Dose Reductions Related to Safety or Tolerability Data Further Support Development Strategy Across Lines of Therapy and in Combination With Approved Therapies, Positioning Cemsidomide as a Potential Foundational Therapy for Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma WATERTOWN, Mass., June 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- C4 Therapeutics, Inc. (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing targeted protein degradation (TPD) science, will present further analysis from its fully enrolled Phase 1 trial of cemsidomide, a next-generation oral IKZF1/3 degrader, in combination with dexamethasone for the treatment of relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) in a poster presentation at the European Hematology Association (EHA) 2026 Congress on Friday, June 12, 2026 at 6:45 pm CEST / 12:45 pm ET. The analysis is consistent with previous data disclosed from the Phase 1 clinical trial and highlights cemsidomide's anti-myeloma activity and differentiated safety profile, further supporting its development as a potential best-in-class IKF1/3 degrader. The poster will be presented by Sagar Lonial, M.D., FACP, FASCO, chief medical officer at the Winship Cancer Institute at Emory University, and an investigator in the cemsidomide clinical trials. “Despite advances in multiple myeloma therapies, IKZF1/3 degradation remains a foundational treatment strategy across lines of therapy because it is the only approach that addresses the underlying biology of the disease and has the built-in ability to stimulate the immune function, becoming a natural partner for immune therapies. Next-generation IKZF1/3 degraders are expected to help advance treatment regimens for this persistent disease, given data demonstrating their efficacy and tolerability,” said Dr. Lonial. “The clinical activity and safety profile of cemsidomide are highly encouraging for patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma as they continue to seek disease-altering treatment options. The data from the ongoing Phase 1 study support the continued development of cemsidomide for patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma who may benefit from IKZF1/3 degradation.” “The totality of cemsidomide data, particularly data showing that patients have experienced a deepening response over time, continue to demonstrate its potential to deliver a tolerable therapy that can provide sustained benefit for patients who have progressed through other treatment options,” said Len Reyno, M.D., chief medical officer of C4 Therapeutics. “We remain focused on advancing our clinical development strategy to capitalize upon cemsidomide’s differentiated profile in hopes patients at various stages of their treatment journey may be able to benefit from this important investigational therapeutic regimen.” The poster presentation includes data on 73 patients with a data cutoff of February 27, 2026. Patients were heavily pretreated, receiving a median of seven prior lines of therapy. Fifty-five patients (75%) received prior BCMA therapy, and 55 patients (75%) received prior CAR-T or T-cell engager therapy (TCE). At the RP2D and maximum tolerated dose (100 µg,) cemsidomide achieved a 53% overall response rate (ORR). At the 75 µg dose level, cemsidomide achieved a 40% ORR. Across all doses evaluated, cemsidomide achieved a 36% ORR. Key new data include: Responses deepened over time across the cemsidomide 75 µg and 100 µg dose levels: At 75 µg, one patient whose best response was previously a partial response (PR) deepened to a very good partial response (VGPR). At 100 µg, several patients achieved a deeper response: One patient whose best response was previously a PR deepened to a stringent complete response (sCR) One patient whose best response was previously a PR deepened to a VGPR Minimal residual disease (MRD) negativity was achieved in two patients who achieved a sCR and complete response (CR) at 100 µg. ORR was consistent across key subgroups: ORR % (95% confidence interval (CI)) All Doses Prior CAR-T or TCE 37% (24, 51) Prior BCMA 33% (21, 48) Prior Lines of Therapy > 5 Lines 33% (20, 48) 100 µg (RP2D) Prior CAR-T or TCE 53% (28, 77) Prior BCMA 47% (21, 73) Prior Lines of Therapy > 5 Lines 47% (21, 73) Durable responses were observed across all dose levels: Patients experienced a median duration of response of 7.9 months (95% CI, 3.0 – non-evaluable). Seven patients remain on treatment currently. Cemsidomide in combination with dexamethasone was generally well tolerated. Incidences of on-target neutropenia remained manageable; 42 patients (58%) experienced Grade 3/4 neutropenia. All treatment emergent adverse events were manageable with no discontinuations deemed related to cemsidomide and minimal dose reductions (five patients; 7%). UPCOMING INVESTOR EVENTS June 18, 2026 at 9 am ET: C4T will host an educational webinar with Nisha Joseph, M.D., associate professor at the Winship Cancer Institute at Emory University and investigator in the cemsidomide clinical trials to discuss the evolving multiple myeloma landscape, the role of IKZF1/3 degradation in treating multiple myeloma, and cemsidomide’s profile. About Cemsidomide Cemsidomide is an investigational, next-generation orally bioavailable MonoDAC® degrader (molecular glue) of IKZF1/3, transcription factors foundational to multiple myeloma biology. Data from the fully enrolled Phase 1 trial show cemsidomide’s differentiated safety and tolerability profile and potentially class-leading anti-myeloma activity that support the potential for durable outcomes. About Multiple Myeloma Multiple myeloma is a blood cancer that affects plasma cells in the bone marrow. It is the second most common blood cancer, with approximately 36,000 people in the United States diagnosed each year. Multiple myeloma is characterized by cycles of remission and relapse, which leads to patients needing multiple lines of therapy to manage this persistent disease. More than 175,000 patients in the United States are estimated to be living with or in remission from myeloma. However, despite treatment advances, approximately 40% of patients do not survive beyond five years. About IKZF1/3 Degradation Targeted degradation of IKZF1 (Ikaros) and IKF3 (Aiolos) is a foundational therapeutic strategy to treat multiple myeloma, a blood cancer affecting plasma cells. IKZF1/3 degradation leads to downregulation of IRF4, which promotes myeloma cell death. IKZF1/3 degradation also activates T-cells, which contributes to broader anti-myeloma response. For decades, IKZF1/3 degradation has been used in approved therapies for multiple myeloma. Next-generation IKZF1/3 degraders are being developed to leverage advances in targeted protein degradation research while continuing to address the biology foundational to multiple myeloma. About the MOMENTUM Trial MOMENTUM (Multi-center trial Of cemsidoMidE iN relapsed/refracTory mUltiple Myeloma) is a Phase 2, open-label, single-arm study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of cemsidomide in combination with dexamethasone in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma. Data from the Phase 1 trial identified 100 µg as the recommended Phase 2 dose. The primary endpoint is overall response rate per International Myeloma Working Group response criteria, as assessed by an independent review committee. Approximately 100 patients who have received at least three prior anti-myeloma regimens that must have included an IKZF1/3 degrader, a proteasome inhibitor, an anti-CD38 antibody, and a T-cell engager or CAR-T therapy will be enrolled in the trial. More information is available at clinicaltrials.gov (NCT07284758). About Cemsidomide in Combination With Elranatamab (ELREXFIO ® ) The Phase 1b trial is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability and preliminary efficacy of cemsidomide and dexamethasone in combination with elranatamab, an FDA-approved B-cell maturation antigen CD3 targeted bispecific antibody. Data generated from the cemsidomide Phase 1 trial in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma demonstrate robust T-cell activation and cytokine expression across multiple doses. By activating immune T-cells, cemsidomide, when combined with a BCMAxCD3 bispecific such as elranatamab, may amplify the anti-myeloma immune response and lead to deeper and more durable responses. The study will evaluate different cemsidomide dose levels (beginning with 75 µg, with the opportunity to simultaneously explore 50 µg and 100 µg) in patients who have received one to four prior lines of therapy, which must have consisted of at least one IKZF1/3 degrader. Exclusion criteria for patients include those who have received prior treatment with a BCMA-directed T-cell engager or BCMA-directed CAR-T therapy. More information is available at clinicaltrials.gov (NCT07280013). About C4 Therapeutics C4 Therapeutics (C4T) (Nasdaq: CCCC) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to delivering on the promise of targeted protein degradation science to create a new generation of medicines that transforms patients’ lives. C4T is progressing targeted oncology programs through clinical studies and leveraging its TORPEDO® platform to efficiently design and optimize small-molecule medicines to address difficult-to-treat diseases. C4T’s degrader medicines are designed to harness the body’s natural protein recycling system to rapidly degrade disease-causing proteins, offering the potential to overcome drug resistance, drug undruggable targets and improve patient outcomes. For more information, please visit www.c4therapeutics.com. title: Laylo Launches AI Ticket Sales Agent to Fill Seats After On-Sale

body_text: The future of ticket sales is personalized. Teams can now sell tickets with ease; DICE is among the first ticketing partners to deploy the agent. Live event organizers can book the perfect venue, lock in the lineup, and spend weeks on promo and still watch ticket sales stall before the event. Some fans land on the ticket page and leave. Some make it to checkout and don't finish. Some have already bought and would bring three friends if someone just asked. To meet this demand, Laylo launched the AI Ticket Sales Agent today. As the CRM and drop platform built for live event teams and trusted by Outside Lands, All Things Go, FISHER and Ariana Grande, we designed this agent to follow up with fans based on what they actually did, in the voice of the artist or promoter, automatically. You just toggle it on. There are no workflows to build. How It Works: Closing the Gap After the Drop Our Agent monitors fan behavior in real time to pick up exactly where your initial on-sale leaves off. Using fan profile data in your Laylo CRM, the agent: Recovers sales from “almost buyers”: Your Agent re-engages fans who RSVPed or clicked your link, giving them a direct, personal path back to checkout. Turns ticket buyers into your street team : Your agent also amplifies promotions with spotting superfans and prompting them to bring friends. One buyer becomes three. The Agent personalizes the message for every single fan based on data like previous buying behavior and location, so it feels like a 1-on-1 text: 📱 "Kiley, don't forget to bring the crew. Tickets are almost gone." 📱 "Amalia, hope to see you at tonight's show." 📱 "Your #1 artist on Spotify is in town this weekend, Riley." Trusted by Industry Leaders DICE , the weirdly easy ticketing platform trusted by independent venues and festivals globally, is among the first partners deploying it. Stranger Than is also among the first promoters using the Agent to drive ticket sales and attendance. "Event organizers spend weeks building the hype, then lose sales in the gap between announcement and door. The Ticket Sales Agent picks up where the drop leaves off and closes that gap. Our mission is to make the process of buying gig tickets as easy, quick and transparent as possible. Alongside the DICE fan messaging, Laylo’s AI Ticket Sales Agent will help our fans, and provide an essential tool to independent promoters to maximise attendance at their artists’ shows."— Simon Kempner , COO of DICE Ready to put your ticket sales on autopilot? (NYSE: GCO) today announced the appointment of Jonathan Collins as Senior Vice
body_text: Genesco Names Jonathan Collins Chief Financial Officer June 29, 2026 at 6:50 AM EDT PDF Version --Proven Global Retail Finance Executive Brings Deep Financial, Operational and Capital Markets Expertise to Support Genesco’s Footwear First Strategy-- NASHVILLE, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jun. 29, 2026-- Genesco Inc. (NYSE: GCO) today announced the appointment of Jonathan Collins as Senior Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer, effective August 3, 2026, following a comprehensive search process. Collins will report directly to Genesco Board Chair, President and Chief Executive Officer Mimi E. Vaughn, who has served as Interim Chief Financial Officer since March 2026. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260628971377/en/ Jonathan Collins, Senior Vice President, Finance, and Chief Financial Officer, Genesco Inc. (NYSE: GCO) “Jonathan is an accomplished finance executive with an exceptional combination of public company leadership and multi-channel global retail expertise,” said Vaughn. “Throughout his career, he has demonstrated the ability to strengthen financial organizations, drive operational discipline and support profitable growth. His broad experience across consumer-facing, large-scale, retail and e-commerce businesses, combined with his strategic financial acumen, makes him an outstanding addition to our leadership team, as we continue executing our Footwear First strategy and creating shareholder value.” Collins brings an impressive record of more than 30 years of senior financial experience. He spent more than a decade with Walmart (from 2012 to 2025) in a series of successive executive leadership roles, including Chief Financial Officer of Walmart Africa, Chief Accounting Officer of Flipkart Group, and Chief Accounting Officer of Walmart Canada. Across these positions, he was instrumental in helping drive growth, operational improvements, capital allocation strategies and business transformation. Most recently, he served as Chief Financial Officer of America’s Car-Mart, Inc., where he led significant improvement initiatives, including strengthening the company’s capital structure, enhancing financial operations and implementing long-range planning and performance management processes. “I am honored and humbled to join Genesco at such an exciting time in the Company’s growth journey,” said Collins. “Genesco’s portfolio of powerful footwear brands and impactful Footwear First strategy create a compelling foundation for future growth with clear momentum underway. I look forward to partnering with Mimi, the Board and the leadership team to help advance the Company’s strategic priorities and create value for shareholders.” About Jonathan Collins Collins brings more than three decades of financial leadership experience ranging from large-scale global retail operations to leading e-commerce platforms across North America, Africa and Asia. He joins Genesco after serving as Chief Financial Officer of America’s Car-Mart, Inc. (2025 to 2026) where he led efforts to recapitalize the company and strengthen financial operations. Previously, Collins spent 13 years with Walmart in senior leadership roles, including Chief Financial Officer of Walmart Africa, where he led the finance function for the $5 billion retail subsidiary operating across eight African countries, improving overall costs and profitability, and as Chief Accounting Officer of Flipkart Group, comprising Flipkart, India’s largest e-commerce platform with $15 billion in revenue, and PhonePe, India’s largest fintech platform with $1 billion in revenue and $1.5 trillion in payment transactions value. As Chief Accounting Officer of Walmart Canada, a $25 billion Walmart subsidiary, he led a comprehensive transformation in controllership empowering teams for more strategic, value adding work. Earlier in his career, Collins was a partner with KPMG, where he led global strategic advisory engagements across the U.S., China and Australia. He holds a Master of Business Administration and a Master of Science in Accounting from the University of Illinois, a Bachelor of Science in Accounting from Western Governors University and a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Kennesaw State University. Collins is a Certified Public Accountant. The Deco offers: $69 / UK sizing: bands 28-38, cups B-J. Freya uses UK sizing, where cup letters run differently above DD. If you're used to US sizes, check a UK-to-US conversion chart before ordering. Smooth molded cups with no seaming at the cup face Low, narrow center gore designed to sit flat on the sternum Underwire structure provides lift and separation for fuller busts The Deco is a long-running favorite among fuller, more projected busts. Across years of reviews, the dominant pattern is fit discovery: women who'd struggled with sizing and support elsewhere describe finally finding a bra that works. That creates a visible line under thin or fitted tops. This isn't a recent-batch issue. It shows up across multiple years of reviews. Best for: Close-set readers in the full-bust range (C cup and above) who need underwire structure and want the lowest center gore available in that size range. Be aware of the top-edge visibility issue under fitted or thin tops. #3 Le Mystere Dream Tisha Bra: Best full-coverage T-shirt bra for close-set, larger bust The Tisha is engineered for larger busts (C-G/DDDD), and its construction argument for close-set placement comes from the sides, not the center. Wide, stabilizing side wings anchor tissue laterally rather than relying on a tall center gore to do the structural work. For a close-set reader in this size range, that matters: the bra holds tissue in place from the outer chest rather than requiring a high center panel that would press against converging breast tissue. This is a full-coverage pick, not a plunge. Whether the center gore height works for close-set placement depends on how close-set you are and where your tissue converges. The side-wing anchoring is the primary construction benefit here. The repeat-purchase track record is unusually strong in this category. #4 LIVELY The Spacer Balconette T-Shirt Bra: Best balconette for close-set breasts in everyday wear Balconette construction is geometrically suited to close-set breasts. The cups are cut horizontally across the top, which tilts the cup angle outward and upward rather than angling it toward the sternum. For close-set placement, the cups work with natural breast positioning rather than directing tissue inward. The outward cup tilt, not the neckline depth, is the functional variable. That's a different argument than "plunge bras work for close-set breasts," and it addresses a different mechanical problem. The LIVELY Spacer puts that construction in a breathable, everyday-wear package. What it offers: $55 / Bands 32-38, cups B-DD Spacer fabric construction: breathable and structured without molded foam Balconette cup profile with a horizontal neckline Underwire for lift and shape Softness is the word reviewers use most frequently. They describe the fabric as "so soft," the straps and band as "conforming, not scratchy or digging." Several say they forget they're wearing it by the end of the day. The convertible racerback clip is a useful feature for the right top, though only a handful of reviewers describe using it day-to-day. Underwire comfort is more mixed. Several reviewers found it "a little pokey" or felt it through the fabric after limited wear. Others report no issues at all. It seems to depend on individual sensitivity to underwire. A few reviewers also found the sizing guide pointed them to the wrong size and recommend ordering their usual size rather than following the brand's tool. Best for: Close-set readers in the B-DD range who want an underwire bra with a balconette cup angle for everyday wear and who prioritize softness. Underwire comfort reports are mixed, so this may not work for readers sensitive to wire pressure. #5 Cosabella Never Say Never Sweetie Padded Bralette: Best lace bralette for close-set, small-to-medium bust The Sweetie's soft triangle panels apply no directional force on breast tissue. There's no underwire, no center gore, and no structural element pushing tissue in any direction. For close-set breasts, that's a structurally neutral option: it won't compress toward center, but it also won't actively separate. This is a bralette, not a solution to a construction problem. The features and pricing: $85 / XS-XL. Cosabella uses S/M/L/XL band sizing rather than numerical bands. Check the brand's size chart for band equivalencies before ordering. Soft stretch lace, no underwire Padded triangle cups with no center gore Light support for low-impact, everyday wear Reviews across Cosabella's site confirm the Sweetie is soft, invisible under clothes, and a repeat purchase among smaller-busted women who've struggled to find anything with shape. Several reviewers mention owning it in multiple colors and treating it as an everyday staple. This is a light-support bralette, not a structured bra. It won't provide real lift, and it's not the pick for a larger bust or high-impact wear. Best for: Small-to-medium bust readers who want a lace bralette with light, no-show support for low-impact wear. The construction is structurally neutral for close-set placement: no compression, no separation. #6 Pepper Signature All You Bra: Best underwire bra for close-set, small bust (AA-B) Standard bras in the AA-B range are frequently constructed with cups that are too widely spaced for small busts. That means empty fabric at the inner cup, visible gaping, and in some cases cups that pull tissue outward away from center. For close-set breasts in this size range, it creates the opposite problem. Instead of compression toward the sternum, you get cups that don't make contact where tissue naturally sits. Pepper's All You Bra is engineered to eliminate that gap. Its contour cups are designed to sit flush at the inner cup without empty space. For a close-set reader with AA-B cups, the construction won't gape at the inner cup where breast tissue is closest to center. What the All You offers: $60 / Bands 30-42, cups AA-B Contour cups engineered for AA-B volume with no gaping at inner cup Underwire for structure and shape Bands 30-42 is unusually broad for AA-B offerings. Most brands limit small-cup options to a narrow band range. The gap-free fit is what reviewers came for and what they report getting. "Finally No Gaps," wrote one buyer. Another confirmed: "fits like it was custom made just for me." The theme of inner-cup contact without empty fabric recurs across the review record. Several reviewers say this is the first bra in years that's fit their proportions — whether a wide rib cage with a smaller cup or vice versa — without the empty fabric or awkward sizing they're used to. The lace detailing gets called out as feminine and well-made. A couple of reviewers reported the lace overlay fraying or coming apart after one or two washes, even when hand-washed carefully. Worth monitoring if you buy. Best for: Close-set readers with AA-B cup sizing who want an underwire bra with a contour cup that fits flush at the inner cup without gaping. The gap-free claim is well-supported by the review record. The right construction for close-set breasts starts with Honeylove Close-set breasts don't need a different size, they need a different construction. Gore height and cup angle determine whether a bra's structure works with close-set placement or against it. The Honeylove CrossOver Bra is our top pick for close-set breasts. Its full coverage wireless cups eliminate center-gore pressure and redirect force outward and forward instead of toward the sternum. Before ordering, use Honeylove's bra size calculator to confirm your fit and choose between the Original, Contour, and V-Neck cup profiles. The V-Neck version is the strongest option for close-set placement where tissue converges high on the sternum. Honeylove offers free 30-day returns and exchanges, so you can try the right cup version without risk. Close-set breasts FAQs Below are the most common questions about bra fit for close-set breasts. What does 'close-set breasts' mean? Close-set breasts have less than one finger-width of space between them at the sternum. Breast tissue begins close to or at the center of the chest, which means bra construction that assumes a gap between breasts — like a tall center gore — will press against tissue rather than sitting flat. It's a placement characteristic, not a size or shape issue. Why do most plunge bras not work for close-set breasts? A plunge bra lowers the neckline, but it doesn't change where the center gore sits relative to breast tissue or how the cups angle tissue. Many plunge bras still have a center gore that presses against converging tissue, and cups that angle inward rather than outward. The neckline depth is cosmetic. The mechanical variables that matter are gore height, cup angle, and support direction. What bra style should you avoid if you have close-set breasts? Full-coverage bras with tall center gores are the most likely to cause problems. The taller the gore, the more center-panel fabric sits on top of converging tissue, creating pressure and compression toward the sternum. Bras with rigid center structures and inward-angling cups compound the issue. Look for low-gore or no-gore construction with cups that tilt outward. Can you wear a wireless bra if you have close-set breasts? Yes, and wireless bras can be a strong option for close-set placement. Without an underwire anchoring the center gore, there's less rigid structure pressing against the sternum. The Honeylove CrossOver Lace Bra takes this further by eliminating the center gore entirely and generating support from crossover panels that originate at the outer chest. The key is finding wireless construction that provides lateral support and forward projection rather than compression.

body_text: The Rise of Social Commerce in Pakistan: How to Earn with Markaz and Instagram The world of commerce is undergoing a dramatic shift. Gone are the days of needing a physical store or a hefty website to launch your entrepreneurial dreams. Today, the power of social media platforms like Instagram is paving the way for a new wave of business owners – social commerce resellers . Here in Pakistan, this trend is taking off in a big way. Platforms like Markaz are empowering individuals, freelancers, students, and especially women entrepreneurs to tap into a massive online marketplace and earn impressive incomes, all from the comfort of their homes. Markaz: Your Gateway to Earning with Social Commerce Markaz is a revolutionary online marketplace bursting with over 100,000 live products across diverse categories, ranging from fashion and electronics to homeware and beauty essentials. Think of it as your one-stop shop for everything trendy and in demand. But Markaz goes beyond just offering a vast product selection. It's specifically designed to empower resellers like you. Here's how: Effortless Reselling: Markaz simplifies the entire reselling process. You don't need to invest in inventory or worry about logistics. Curated Collections: Markaz offers a curated selection of high-quality, trending products, ensuring you have access to what your potential customers are looking for. Competitive Margins: Markaz provides attractive commission rates, allowing you to earn a significant income from every sale you make. The average reseller on Markaz earns upwards of PKR 45,000 per month – a sign of the platform's earning potential. Passive Income Potential: Promote products you love on your social media channels, and watch the sales (and your income) grow, even while you sleep. The Perfect Match: Markaz and Instagram The beauty of Markaz lies in its simple integration with social media platforms like Instagram. This allows you to tap into the power of Instagram's massive user base to showcase products, connect with potential customers, and ultimately drive sales – all without needing a website. Selling products on Instagram through Markaz opens exciting doors for Pakistani entrepreneurs. By utilizing effective Instagram marketing strategies, you can transform your profile into a powerful sales channel. In the next section, we'll delve deeper into the world of Instagram reselling and equip you with the tools and strategies to turn your social media presence into a thriving online business. Here, we'll discuss the importance of establishing a professional Instagram business account and explore the possibilities of Instagram Shopping to further streamline your reselling journey. Choosing the Right Instagram Account: Like Picking the Perfect Shop Location So, you're ready to jump into the exciting world of selling on Instagram with Markaz? Awesome! But before you start snapping photos of all those amazing products, there's one crucial step: picking the right account. Think of it like choosing the perfect location for your shop – you want it to be inviting, informative, and set you up for success. Why a Regular Account Won't Cut It While you might be tempted to use your personal Instagram account, for serious resellers like you, a dedicated business account is a game-changer. It's like having a VIP pass to a whole new world of features designed to help you sell more. Business Account Perks: Like Having Superpowers for Selling See Who's Interested: Imagine knowing exactly who your customers are and what kind of products they love. With a business account, you get access to special insights that show you things like follower demographics and which posts are getting the most love. This lets you tailor your content to what resonates best, making your sales soar. Connect Easily: Want to make buying from you a breeze? A business account lets you display your contact info (phone number, email) right on your profile. It's like having a virtual "open for business" sign, making it super easy for customers to reach out with questions or place orders. Action Buttons: Make Taking the Next Step Easy Imagine having little buttons on your profile that say things like "Contact Us" or "Email Us." With a business account, that's a reality! These handy buttons make it super simple for potential customers to get in touch and start a conversation – no more hunting for your contact details. Level Up with Ads (Later, Not Now!): While you're starting out, focus on rocking free methods, but keep this in mind for future growth. Business accounts unlock the power of Instagram Ads . Imagine being able to target your ideal customers with laser precision, showing them exactly the products they're craving. This can seriously expand your reach and bring in a whole new wave of buyers. Switching to a Business Account: Easier Than You Think Making the switch to a business account is a breeze! Just follow these steps within the Instagram app : Open the app and head to your profile. Tap the three lines in the top right corner (think of it like your secret menu button). Select "Settings" and then "Account." Look for "Switch to Business Account" and tap on it. It's like flipping a switch to unlock all those cool features. You might be asked to connect your Facebook account (if you have one). This just helps streamline things and unlocks some advertising tools you can use later. Fill in your business info, like your contact details and what kind of products you sell (fashion, electronics, etc.). Review, confirm, and voila! You're officially a business owner on Instagram. Crafting Your Shopfront: Make Your Profile Pop! Now that you have a business account, it's time to create an Instagram business profile that's basically a virtual shopfront for all your amazing Markaz products. Here's how to make it shine: Eye-Catching Profile Pic: Think of this as your shop sign. Choose a clear, recognizable image that represents your brand (like a logo). Bio That Sells: This is your chance to tell everyone in a nutshell what you're all about. Keep it short, sweet, and mention that you're using Markaz to bring awesome products to your followers. End with a call to action, like inviting people to check out your latest finds or send you a message to learn more. Highlight Reel: Imagine having mini-sections in your profile to showcase different product categories, customer reviews, or even behind-the-scenes glimpses of your business. That's what Highlights are for! Use them to create a well-organized and engaging profile that keeps people wanting more. Bonus Tips for Profile Awesomeness Keyword Magic: Sprinkle relevant keywords throughout your bio and captions. This helps people find you when they search for specific products on Instagram. Brand Consistency is Key: Think of your profile as a visual story. Use a consistent style for your photos and videos to create a recognizable brand image. Instagram Checkout (Coming Soon!): In some countries, there's a feature called Instagram Checkout that lets people buy products directly within the app. While it's not available in Pakistan yet, keep it on your radar for future updates! Crafting a Compelling Profile: Your Secret Weapon for Attracting Instagram Customers We've established your Instagram business account as the foundation for your reselling success. Now, let's get creative and build a captivating instagram business profile that acts like a magnet, attracting potential customers and turning them into loyal fans. Remember, on Instagram, first impressions are everything. Here's how to craft a profile that stands out from the crowd and gets those "follows" rolling in: The Power of Visual Storytelling: Make Your Feed a Feast for the Eyes Instagram is a visual platform, so high-quality photos and videos are non-negotiable. Here are some tips to ensure your feed is visually stunning: Invest in Good Lighting: Natural light is your best friend! But if you're shooting indoors, invest in some basic lighting equipment to banish shadows and create crisp, clear visuals. Master the Art of Composition: Don't just snap random photos. Think about what you want to showcase and how to frame the shot. Experiment with different angles and layouts to create visually interesting content. Editing is Your Friend: Don't be afraid to use editing tools to enhance your photos and videos. Free apps like Snapseed or Lightroom Mobile offer a variety of filters and adjustments to help you achieve a professional look. Consistency is Key: Develop a consistent visual theme for your profile. This could involve using similar color palettes, editing styles, or even props in your photos. Consistency creates a sense of brand recognition and makes your profile instantly recognizable to Instagram users . Beyond the Photos: Crafting Compelling Captions While visuals grab attention, captions are where you tell the story behind the product. Here's how to write captions that convert: Be Informative: Briefly describe the product, its key features, and any benefits it offers. Think about the problems your target audience faces and how this product can solve them. Spark Conversation: Don't just list specifications. Ask questions, encourage users to share their thoughts, or run a quick poll to generate engagement. Embrace Humor or Storytelling: People love to be entertained! Infuse your captions with a touch of humor or tell a short story about how the product could be used. Include a Call to Action (CTA): Don't be shy! Tell people what you want them to do after reading your caption. Do you want them to visit your Markaz store, send you a DM to inquire, or maybe participate in a contest? A clear CTA increases the chances of them taking action. Hashtags: The Secret Language of Discovery Hashtags are like keywords on Instagram. Using relevant hashtags helps your instagram page get discovered by people searching for those specific terms. Here are some hashtag tips: Research is Key: Don't just throw in random hashtags. Use tools like Hashtagify.me or Later to research popular hashtags related to your products and target audience. Mix it Up: Use a combination of broad and niche hashtags. Broader hashtags help with general discovery, while niche hashtags target a more specific audience. Don't Go Overboard: Instagram allows up to 30 hashtags per post, but sticking to 10-15 relevant ones is ideal. Instagram Stories: Your Daily Dose of Engagement Instagram Stories are a powerful tool to connect with your audience in a more informal and interactive way. Here's how to leverage stories for maximum impact: Post Regularly: Aim to post stories at least once a day, offering behind-the-scenes glimpses, "Try-on" sessions of products, or quick polls to gauge customer interest. Get Creative with Features: Explore the various features available in stories, like stickers, polls, questions, and live streams. These interactive elements keep your audience engaged and coming back for more. Promote Your Markaz Store: Use stories to showcase new product arrivals from Markaz, run flash sales, or offer exclusive discounts to your followers. The Power of DMs: Building Relationships with Your Audience Instagram DMs (direct messages) are a fantastic way to have personalized conversations with potential customers. Here's how to use them effectively: Respond Promptly: Make it a habit to check your DMs regularly and respond to inquiries in a timely manner. This shows you care about your customers and builds trust. Provide Excellent Customer Service: Use DMs to answer product questions, address any concerns, and facilitate the buying process. Go the Extra Mile: Occasionally, send a friendly message to a customer who has shown interest in a product or has placed an order. This personal touch can foster loyalty and encourage repeat business. Beyond the Basics: Optimizing Your Profile for the Instagram Algorithm Remember, Instagram is a crowded space, and the ever-evolving algorithm dictates what content users see. Here are some additional tips to optimize your profile and get your content noticed: Post Consistently: Develop a regular posting schedule and stick to it. This trains the algorithm to recognize your content and increases the chances of it showing up in your follower's feeds. Engagement is King: Instagram prioritizes posts that generate engagement. Encourage interaction by asking questions, running contests, and responding to comments. Utilize Location Tags and Geotags: Adding location tags to your posts helps people in your area discover your profile. This can be particularly effective if you're targeting a local audience. Collaborate with Other Resellers: Partnering with other resellers who complement your product offerings can expose your profile to a new audience and boost engagement. Advanced Strategies: Taking Your Profile to the Next Level As you establish your presence and gain traction, consider these advanced strategies for further optimizing your profile: Run Instagram Ads (Optional): While not essential for beginners, (consider this for future growth) Instagram Ads allow you to target specific demographics with laser focus. This can be a powerful tool to reach a wider audience and attract highly interested customers. Utilize Instagram Analytics: Business accounts provide access to valuable analytics data. Analyze which content performs best, what times your audience is most active, and demographics of your followers. This data helps you refine your content strategy and tailor it for maximum impact. Stay Updated with Instagram Trends: Instagram is constantly evolving, with new features and trends emerging regularly. Stay informed about these updates and experiment with new formats like Reels or IGTV to keep your audience engaged and your profile fresh. By consistently creating compelling content, optimizing your profile, and engaging with your audience, you'll transform your Instagram business profile into a magnet for potential customers. Remember, building a successful profile takes time and dedication, but with these strategies at your fingertips, you'll be well on your way to becoming a thriving reseller on Instagram with Markaz as your partner in success. Promoting Your Products: Turning Followers into Paying Customers We've established the foundation (your business account and a captivating profile) for your Instagram reselling journey with Markaz. Now, it's time to look at the exciting world of promoting your products and turning those interested followers into loyal, paying customers. Here are several effective strategies to consider: ‍ Harnessing the Power of Instagram Shop (When Available): The dream scenario for many resellers is having access to Instagram Shop . This feature, currently being rolled out in select regions, allows you to create a virtual storefront directly within Instagram. While not yet available in Pakistan, keep this exciting development in mind for the future. Here's how Instagram Shop can revolutionize your reselling experience: Effortless Product Listings: Upload product details and optimized-images directly to Instagram. No need for a separate ecommerce website or online store setup. Shoppable Posts: Imagine your feed posts featuring products with clickable tags. Users can tap the tag to learn more and easily proceed to checkout – all within the Instagram app! This creates a frictionless buying experience that can significantly boost sales. Inventory Management: Keep track of your product inventory directly through Instagram Shop, ensuring you never advertise out-of-stock items. Even Without Instagram Shop, There are Plenty of Ways to Sell: While Instagram Shop offers a streamlined experience, fret not if it's not yet available in your region. Here are effective strategies to promote your Markaz products and convert followers into customers: Make Use of Your Bio: Your Instagram bio is prime real estate. Include a clear call to action (CTA) mentioning Markaz and how users can purchase the products they see on your profile. Consider mentioning keywords like "Shop Now" or "Link in Bio" to guide them towards your desired action. The Power of Feed Posts: Regularly showcase your Markaz products through high-quality photos and captivating videos in your feed posts. Utilize storytelling elements to highlight product features and benefits. Tap into the Magic of Hashtags: Don't underestimate the power of relevant hashtags. Research popular hashtags related to your products and target audience to increase discoverability. Stories: A Platform for Engagement: Instagram Stories offer a fantastic opportunity to showcase products in a more informal and interactive way. Use features like polls, questions, and product demos to keep your audience engaged and drive interest in your offerings. Creative Content Strategies for Maximum Impact: Here are some additional content ideas to keep your audience hooked and itching to buy: Curated Collections: Create "lookbooks" showcasing how your products can be mixed and matched to create different styles. Behind-the-Scenes Glimpses: Offer your followers a peek into your world by sharing short videos or photos of you finding new products on Markaz or packaging orders. User-Generated Content (UGC) is King: Encourage your followers to share photos or videos using your products with a branded hashtag. UGC builds trust and authenticity, as potential customers see real people enjoying your products. Consider running contests or giveaways to incentivize UGC creation. Exploring Paid Advertising: Expanding Your Reach (Optional): While not essential for beginners, consider influencer marketing as your business grows. Partnering with relevant micro-influencers on Instagram can expose your brand to a wider audience and leverage their established trust with their followers. Building Trust and Converting Sales: Here are some additional tips to convert followers into paying customers: Respond to Comments: The comment section is a valuable space for interaction. Respond to comments promptly and professionally, address any questions, and express gratitude for positive feedback. Offer Multiple Payment Options: Provide your customers with convenient payment options . While cash on delivery (COD) is popular in Pakistan, explore offering online payment options as well, catering to customers who prefer digital transactions. Remember: Building a successful online business takes time, dedication, and a strategic approach. By consistently creating high-quality content, optimizing your profile, engaging with your audience, and promoting your Markaz products effectively, you'll be well on your way to turning your passion for reselling into a thriving career. Bonus Tip: Explore Facebook Integration (For Future Reference): While focusing on Instagram is a great start, keep in mind the potential of integrating your Instagram profile with a Facebook Business Page . This allows you to manage both platforms from one central location ( Business Manager account ) and potentially unlock additional advertising opportunities. ‍ The Key Takeaway: A Content Plan is Your Roadmap to Success Developing a solid content plan is crucial for promoting your products effectively. This plan should outline the type of content you'll create, the posting schedule, and the target audience for. Converting Sales: Transforming Interest into Loyal Customers You've crafted a captivating profile, mastered the art of content creation, and attracted a dedicated following on Instagram. Now comes the crucial step: converting sales . Here's how to transform those interested followers into loyal, paying customers: ‍ The Power of High Engagement: Remember, a high engagement rate is key to success on Instagram. People are more likely to buy from brands they feel connected to. Here are some strategies to boost engagement and build trust: Respond to Comments Promptly and Professionally: The comment section is a two-way street. Respond to comments, answer questions, address concerns, and express gratitude for positive feedback. This demonstrates that you care about your customers and fosters a sense of community. Run Contests and Giveaways: Everyone loves a good giveaway! Organize contests or giveaways with exciting Markaz products as prizes. This encourages participation, increases brand awareness, and incentivizes people to follow your profile. Run Polls and Ask Questions: Spark conversations with your audience by running polls and asking questions in your stories or posts. This allows you to understand their preferences, tailor your content accordingly, and create a more interactive experience. Building Trust and Authority: The Customer Experience Matters In the age of online shopping, the customer experience is paramount. Here's how to ensure a smooth and positive experience for your Instagram customers: Provide Excellent Customer Support: Be readily available to answer questions through DMs or comments. Respond promptly, address all concerns professionally, and strive to resolve any issues efficiently. This builds trust and shows customers you prioritize their satisfaction. Offer Multiple Payment Options: Catering to a variety of payment preferences is crucial. While cash on delivery (COD) is popular in Pakistan, explore offering secure online payment options as well. This gives your customers flexibility and creates a more convenient buying experience. Deliver on Your Promises: Be transparent about product details, shipping timelines, and commerce policies . Ensure your products are accurately described and that orders are shipped promptly. This builds trust and encourages repeat business. Leveraging Instagram's Shopping Features (When Available): If Instagram Shop is available in your region, utilize it to its full potential. Here's how these features can streamline the buying process and convert sales: Product Catalog: Upload detailed product descriptions, high-quality photos, and variations (size, color) to your product catalog within Instagram Shop. This allows users to easily browse your offerings and access all relevant information. Shoppable Posts: Take advantage of shoppable posts . These allow you to tag products directly within your feed posts. Users can then click the tag to learn more about the product and cleanly proceed to checkout – all within the Instagram app! This eliminates friction and simplifies the buying journey. Product Stickers in Stories: Don't neglect Stories! Utilize product stickers to showcase your Markaz products in a more dynamic way. Users can tap the sticker to access product information and potentially initiate a purchase. Making the Most of Limited Functionality (When Instagram Shop Isn't Available): Even without Instagram Shop, there are still effective ways to encourage sales on Instagram: Landing Pages: If you have your own e-commerce website, include a clear and clickable link in your bio that directs users to a dedicated landing page specifically designed for Markaz products. Order Forms: Consider using third-party solutions like Google Forms or Typeform to create simple order forms. Customers can fill out the form within Instagram DMs, specifying their desired product and contact details. You can then process the order manually. Clear Calls to Action (CTAs): Tell your audience exactly what you want them to do after seeing a post. Do you want them to "DM to Order," "Visit Markaz Link in Bio," or "Comment Below for Details"? Clear CTAs guide users towards the next step and increase conversion rates. The Power of Social Proof: Testimonials and User-Generated Content (UGC): People trust other people's opinions. Tap into the power of social proof to build trust and encourage sales: Showcase Customer Testimonials: Feature positive customer reviews and testimonials in your posts or stories. This shows potential buyers that others have had positive experiences with your products and builds confidence in your brand. Run User-Generated Content (UGC) Campaigns: Encourage your followers to share photos or videos using your products with a branded hashtag. UGC is a powerful tool as it showcases real people enjoying your products and adds a layer of authenticity to your brand. Consider running contests or giveaways to incentivize UGC creation. Optimizing Your Sales Funnel for Maximum Impact Think of your Instagram presence as a funnel, guiding potential customers towards a purchase. Here's how to optimize each stage for maximum impact: Top of the Funnel (Brand Awareness): Focus on attracting new followers and building brand awareness. Use captivating content, relevant hashtags, and collaborations with other businesses to expand your reach. Middle of the Funnel (Engagement): Engage your audience with interactive content like polls, quizzes, and contests. Respond to comments and messages promptly, fostering a sense of community. Showcase your products in a creative and informative way, highlighting their benefits and how they solve customer problems. Bottom of the Funnel (Conversion): Make it easy for people to buy! If you have Instagram Shop, utilize shoppable posts and a well-organized product catalog. If not, provide clear CTAs and offer multiple payment options. Ensure a smooth checkout process and deliver excellent customer support to finalize the sale and turn them into loyal customers. Utilizing Instagram Insights and Analytics (For Business Accounts): Having a business account unlocks access to valuable Instagram Insights . These analytics provide a wealth of data about your audience demographics, post performance, and engagement levels. Here's how to leverage them to optimize your sales funnel: Identify Your Ideal Customer: Use insights to understand your audience's age, location, and interests. This allows you to tailor your content and product offerings to resonate with them more effectively. See What Content Performs Best: Track which posts generate the most engagement and reach. This helps you understand what type of content connects best with your audience and allows you to refine your content strategy for increased sales. Monitor Click-Through Rates (CTRs): Analyze how many people click on the links in your bio or CTAs. A low CTR suggests your message isn't clear or your landing page isn't optimized. Use this data to refine your calls to action and ensure they're compelling and lead to the desired action. Continuous Improvement: The Key to Long-Term Success The world of social media is constantly evolving. Here's how to stay ahead of the curve and ensure your Instagram sales strategy remains effective: Stay Updated with Instagram Trends: New features and trends emerge regularly on Instagram. Stay informed about these updates and experiment with new formats like Reels or IGTV to keep your audience engaged and your profile fresh. Integrate with Facebook Business Manager (Optional): While focusing on Instagram is a great start, consider connecting your Instagram profile to a Facebook Business Page . This allows you to manage both platforms from a central location ( Business Manager account ) and potentially unlocks additional advertising opportunities, like running targeted ads on Facebook to reach a wider audience interested in products like yours. Remember: Building a successful online business takes dedication and a long-term perspective. By consistently creating high-quality content, optimizing your profile, engaging with your audience, promoting your Markaz products effectively, and utilizing the tools and strategies outlined above, you'll be well on your way to transforming your Instagram presence into a thriving sales channel. Embrace the journey, keep learning, and adapt your approach as needed. With dedication and a commitment to providing an exceptional customer experience, you'll cultivate a loyal following and turn your passion for reselling into a sustainable success story on Instagram. Going the Extra Mile: Strategies to Elevate Your Instagram Reselling Success You've established a captivating profile, mastered the art of promoting your Markaz products, and are witnessing promising sales on Instagram. But how do you stand out from the crowd and truly go the extra mile to elevate your reselling success? Here are some advanced strategies to push the boundaries and build a thriving Instagram business: Optimizing Your Instagram Product Listings (Beyond the Basics): While basic product descriptions and photos are essential, consider these strategies to enhance your Instagram product listings : Highlight Unique Selling Points (USPs): What makes your Markaz finds different? Do you specialize in vintage clothing, rare collectibles, or handcrafted items? Emphasize your USPs in your captions, stories, and listings to attract customers looking for something special. Showcase Product Versatility: Don't just show static product photos. Use creative storytelling to demonstrate how your products can be used in different ways or styled for various occasions. This inspires potential buyers and expands their vision for how they can incorporate your offerings into their lives. Utilize High-Quality Videos: While photos are great, high-quality product videos can be even more captivating. Showcase product details, textures, and functionality through engaging video content. This can be especially beneficial for products like clothing, makeup, or electronics requiring a more in-depth look. Mastering the Art of Instagram Shopping Features (When Available): If your region enjoys the privilege of Instagram Shopping , leverage these features to their full potential and streamline the buying process: Curated Collections: Create curated product collections within Instagram Shop, categorized by style, theme, or occasion.
